snippet.title: Gothic 1 Remake | Cinematic Intro [EN]
snippet.description:
"The kingdom of Myrtana, united by King Rhobar II..."

These are the exact words that began your  journey into the Valley of Mines 25 years ago.

In just 3 days, we return to the world of Gothic — this time with a brand new cinematic intro!

Gothic 1 Remake launches on June 5th at 19:00 CEST.
